target: forge.sh pr-state (gitlab) — opened/merged/closed map, locked and anything else are UNKNOWN
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/sub/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
P="/api/v4/projects/grp%2Fsub%2Fproj/merge_requests/7"
U=https://gitlab.example.test/grp/sub/proj/-/merge_requests/7
st() { fx_http "GET $P" 200 "{\"state\":\"$1\"}"; fx_run pr-state "$U"; echo "$1->$FX_OUT rc=$FX_RC"; }
st opened; st merged; st closed; st locked; st draft
fx_http "GET $P" 200 '{"state":""}'; fx_run pr-state "$U"; echo "empty->$FX_OUT rc=$FX_RC"
echo "reqs=$(fx_nreq)"
fx_done
